title: Duke George
lyrics_synced:
[00:06.43] There is a young cowboy
[00:08.79] He lives on the range
[00:12.64] His horse and his cattle
[00:14.79] Are his only companions
[00:19.07] He works in the saddle
[00:21.32] And he sleeps in the canyon
[00:24.32] Waiting for summer
[00:26.57] His pastures to change
[00:33.32] And as the moon rises
[00:35.57] He sits by his fire
[00:38.57] Thinking about women
[00:40.50] And glasses of beer
[00:43.39] And closing his eyes
[00:45.32] As the dogies retire
[00:48.64] He sings out a song
[00:50.36] Which is soft but it's clear
[00:53.79] As if maybe someone could hear
[01:01.61] Goodnight you moonlight ladies
[01:06.64] Rock-a-bye sweet baby James
[01:12.00] Deep greens and blues
[01:13.61] Are the colors I choose
[01:16.50] Won't you let me go down in my dreams
[01:21.86] And rock-a-bye sweet baby James
[01:26.89] Now the first of December
[01:29.79] Was covered in snow
[01:33.75] So was the turnpike
[01:35.89] From Stockbridge to Boston
[01:39.75] Though the Berkshires
[01:41.04] Seemed dream-like
[01:42.32] On account of that frosting
[01:45.21] With ten miles behind me
[01:47.57] And ten thousand more to go
[01:53.89] There's a song that they sing
[01:56.04] When they take to the highway
[01:59.36] A song that they sing
[02:00.86] When they take to the sea
[02:04.29] A song that they sing
[02:06.64] Of their home in the sky
[02:09.32] Maybe you can believe it
[02:12.00] If it helps you to sleep
[02:14.46] But singing works just fine for me
[02:22.61] Goodnight you moonlight ladies
[02:27.86] Rock-a-bye sweet baby James
[02:32.79] Deep greens and blues
[02:34.61] Are the colors I choose
[02:37.61] Won't you let me go down in my dreams
[02:42.75] And Rock-a-bye sweet baby James
